features: Import static 3D mesh files from disk at runtime.
Import mesh data from memory with external file access denied.
Construct Dynamic Mesh or Procedural Mesh data with embedded material and texture support.

codeModules.name: RuntimeAssetImport
codeModules.description: Runtime mesh import and mesh-data construction module.

technicalInformation.networkReplicationNotes: The plugin does not provide network replication; the host project owns replication of any resulting runtime data.
technicalInformation.exampleProjectNotes: A separate example project is not required; the package includes the runtime content asset and documentation, while repository automation covers the import sample assets.
technicalInformation.additionalNotes: Third-party software is bundled: Assimp 6.0.5. The RuntimeAssetImportTest module and its test assets are repository-only and are not shipped in the Fab package.
